name: LongBench
description: LongBench is a bilingual (Chinese-English) benchmark for evaluating long context understanding in LLMs. It covers 21 diverse tasks across 6 categories: single-document QA, multi-document QA, summarization, few-shot learning, synthetic tasks, and code completion. Average input length ranges from 5K to 60K tokens.
evaluation_method: Task-specific: F1, ROUGE, accuracy, code execution
typical_sota_score: ~55-70 average (GPT-4 class; depends on context length)
reputation: First comprehensive bilingual long context benchmark; published as an ACL 2024 paper (arXiv 2308); widely used to evaluate long-context LLMs like Claude, GPT-4, and open-source alternatives
notes: Published 2023 (ACL 2024). Note: longbench_v2.json exists but LongBench v1 is separate. 21 tasks from both English and Chinese. LongBench-E (hard English subset) released separately. Tasks include NarrativeQA, Qasper, MFQA, HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, GovReport, MultiNews, TREC, TriviaQA, SAMSum, PassageCount, PassageRetrieval, LCC, RepoBench-P.
